Messages.Author: gatocion
Messages.Body:
Hi!

The other day, a new player from a playgroup I'm part asked me a question I wasn't able to answer.

Could we build a deck, that is competitive but also cheap?

I have given it a couple of thoughts, and my guess will be a bleed deck, maybe a power bleed Giovanni (without Isabel) or a B&S Dem, but as I'm not sure I would like to propose a challenge.

To build a competitive, but also cheap deck.

Show me your best/crazy ideas fellow Methuselahs!

VEKN#4200008

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
I believe a "classic" weenie DEM would be competitive AND cheap. You could base yourself on this one :

> Italian ECQ
> Genova, Italy
> April 24th 2016
> 3R+F
> 20 players
> Laurent Ribeyre
> www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/8400
>
> Deck Name: Weenie DEM
> Description: Ruben Feldman's deck inspiration
>
> Crypt (12 cards, min=6, max=18, avg=3)  2x Jackie 3 DEM Malkavian antitribu:4
> 2x Midget 3 DEM obf pre Malkavian antitribu:3
> 2x Cassandra Langely, The Waif 2 dem Malkavian:4
> 2x Eddie Gaines 1 dem pot Caitiff:3
> 1x Apache Jones 5 DEM aus for obf Malkavian antitribu:4
> 1x Persia, The Beautiful Statue 5 DEM aus obf Malkavian:3
> 1x Uncle George 5 DEM aus dom obf Malkavian antitribu:3
> 1x Marta 3 aus dem Malkavian antitribu:4
>
> Library (85 cards)
> Master (14; 3 trifle)
> 2x Agent of Power
> 5x Dementation
> 2x Effective Management
> 1x Last Stand
> 1x Misdirection
> 2x Pentex(TM) Subversion
> 1x Wash
>
> Action (30)
> 30x Kindred Spirits
>
> Action Modifier (32)
> 16x Confusion
> 14x Eyes of Chaos
> 2x Mind Tricks
>
> Action Modifier/Combat (8)
> 8x Deny
>
> Event (1)
> 1x Bitter and Sweet Story, The
>
And to make it realy cheap, you would need to ditch the bitter and sweet story and maybe some odd cards I am not aware of its scarcity (Last stand ?). And after that you drop all the numbers to have a 70/75 cards deck and you're fine.

I believe you will have a 30/50 € total cost if you have to buy every single card from sellers.

Easier is to know the budget because "cheap" has a relative meaning. I think the cheapest way is to buy 2x Lasombra Sabbat deck from BC and make a stealth bleed/vote deck.
It's a really strong deck. Someone even win a tournament with just one copy of it.
Also from 2x Toreador! deck you can make a really good deck or just buy 25th and play Stanislava XD

If you are looking for other clans Link provided by Ankha is really good.
